narrative.details:
The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, adventurer.  While we do allow safe passage to those we trust, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.

The Winterfall tribe as of late has become increasingly hostile towards us.  They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.

I must ask you to thin their numbers as to lessen the threat against us.  Seek them out in Winterfall Village, far to the east of here.
narrative.objectives: Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa.  Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you for what you have done, as saddening as it is.  Accept this as a token of thanks.

I would ask of you to please continue helping us, adventurer.  We have very few allies on which to call upon, and without your aid, the threats against my tribe would surely be too much for us to handle alone.
narrative.requestItemsText: We very much appreciate what you have done for the Timbermaw, adventurer. Your continued efforts will surely earn my tribe's trust and respect.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 56 to 58, 6,775 XP in all.
